Sing the chorus of the last song you listened to, as dramatically as possible.
Act out a famous movie scene without words until someone guesses it.
Commentate everything happening at the table like a sports broadcaster for one minute.
Text a family member 'I'm proud of you' right now, no explanation.
Do 10 jumping jacks while saying the alphabet backwards.
Speak only in questions until your next turn.
Give a one-minute TED talk on why your favorite snack is the best.
Let {random} pick a word you can't say until your next turn. Every slip, you owe them a compliment.
Hold a plank for 20 seconds while everyone tries to make you laugh.
Describe your morning routine like a nature documentary narrator.
Do your best runway walk across the room and back.
Write a four-line poem about the drink in front of you and perform it.
Try to lick your elbow. Really commit to it.
Give a toast to {random} like it's their wedding day.
Play a fancy waiter and take everyone's order in an accent of your choice.
Hand your phone to {random} and let them read your latest notification out loud.
Show everyone your screen time report for this week.
Let {random} write your next social media status, keep it wholesome, and post it.
Call a friend who isn't here and sing them happy birthday, even though it's not their birthday.
Swap an accessory (hat, watch, jacket) with {random} until your next turn, if they're up for it.
Send 'I have an announcement' to a group chat and don't explain for five minutes.
Describe your crush using only three emojis and show the group.
Perform a soap-opera crying scene for 15 seconds.
Rap four lines about {random}. Keep it friendly.
Let {left} pick a song from your library, then sing the first verse.
Set your phone wallpaper to a photo the group picks, for the rest of the night.
Text someone you owe an apology to and apologize, right now.
Narrate {right}'s every move like a wildlife documentary for one minute.
Post a throwback photo with the caption 'simpler times.'
Message someone you haven't talked to in over a year: 'Thought of you today, hope you're well!'
Let {random} scroll through your camera roll for ten seconds.
Tell {random} something you've always wanted to say to them.
Give {random} a 30-second hand massage, if they're okay with it.
Let the group pick a contact, then send them a voice note of you singing one line of a love song.
Read out the last message in your oldest unanswered chat.
Tell the group three things you genuinely admire about {random}.
Show the group your most-used emoji and explain who you send it to most.
Let {random} send one wholesome emoji to anyone in your contacts.
Show the group the last person you searched for on Instagram.
Describe your ideal first-kiss setting in exactly ten words.
Let {random} ask you one spicy yes-or-no question. No passing.
Draft a flirty message to your crush, let the group read it, and let them vote on whether you send it.
Give {random} your best smolder for five full seconds, if they're game.
Explain to {random}, with a straight face and eye contact, why they'd make a great partner.
Rate your flirting skills out of 10, then prove it with one line to {random}, if they're game.
